spatial_sensitivity.method: Fixed-design residual wild bootstrap, Rademacher sign per projected spatial cell; percentile sensitivity range, not calibrated spatial CI

location_uncertainty.assumption: Uniform area within each stated-radius disk; scenario, not the empirical error law. Failed draws remain failed, not straight-line replacements.
